GainsBlock.rationale: `public override bool GainsBlock => true` (Relax.cs:15) == the class attribute.

ctor.rationale: `base(3, CardType.Skill, CardRarity.Ancient, TargetType.Self)` (Relax.cs:28-31) == cost 3 / SKILL / ANCIENT / SELF.

CanonicalVars.rationale: `new BlockVar(15m, ValueProp.Move)` + `new CardsVar(2)` + `new EnergyVar(2)` (Relax.cs:17-22) == all three numbers, all declared as SEPARATE fields -- which matters because the upgrade raises them by DIFFERENT amounts (+2/+1/+1), so the collapse card/prowess gets away with would break here. Move without Unpowered -> POWERED block, so NOT in gap G1's blast radius.

OnPlay.rationale: All three steps and their order match: `CreatureCmd.GainBlock(Owner.Creature, DynamicVars.Block, cardPlay)` (Relax.cs:36) == `BlockCmd.apply`, then `PowerCmd.Apply<DrawCardsNextTurnPower>(..., Cards.BaseValue, ...)` (37), then `PowerCmd.Apply<EnergyNextTurnPower>(..., Energy.BaseValue, ...)` (38) -- both == the sim's two `PowerCmd.apply` calls in the same order. Neither the draw nor the energy happens NOW on either side; the two powers deliver them next turn. Presentation, folded in: TriggerAnim (35) and the energy hover tip (24).

OnUpgrade.rationale: `Block.UpgradeValueBy(2m)` + `Cards.UpgradeValueBy(1m)` + `Energy.UpgradeValueBy(1m)` (Relax.cs:43-45) == `_block += 2` (15 -> 17), `_cards += 1` (2 -> 3), `_energy += 1` (2 -> 3). All three upgraded numbers checked, and the +2/+1/+1 asymmetry is exactly the kind of detail a collapsed var would lose.
